title: Curve
text: Approximate one-dimensional function, 1 input, 1 output, {Table data} sets Data type of table data Inherit: Same as; {Targeted Routine Library} Indicates the AUTOSAR routine library used for block code replacement, {Targeted Routine} sets the aUTOSAR library routine used for code replacement, {Data specification} sets the method of table and breakpoint specification Table, {Name}, {Breakpoints specification} sets the method of breakpoint specification Explicit, {Breakpoints} sets the explicit breakpoint values, or first point and spacing of breakpoints, {First point}, {Spacing}, {Edit table and breakpoints} sets the launch Lookup Table Editor dialog box, {Index search method} sets the method of calculating table indices Linear, {Begin index search using previous index result} sets the start using the index from the previous time, {Interpolation method} sets the method of interpolation between breakpoint values Linear and {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output computed by looking up or estimating table values scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Targeted Routine Library
params.values: Indicates the AUTOSAR routine library used for block code replacement IFX (fixed-point) | IFL (floating-point)

params.name: Targeted Routine
params.values: AUTOSAR library routine used for code replacement Ifx_IntIpoCur | Ifl_IntIpoCur

params.name: Data specification
params.values: Method of table and breakpoint specification Table and breakpoints (default) | Lookup table object

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of the lookup table object [] (default) | Simulink.LookupTable object

params.name: Table data
params.values: Define the table of output values [1 2 4] (default) | character vector

params.name: Breakpoints specification
params.values: Method of breakpoint specification Explicit values (default) | Even spacing

params.name: Breakpoints
params.values: Explicit breakpoint values, or first point and spacing of breakpoints [10,22,31] (default) | 1-by-n or n-by-1 vector of monotonically increasing values

params.name: First point
params.values: First point in evenly spaced breakpoint data 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Spacing
params.values: Spacing between evenly spaced breakpoints 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Edit table and breakpoints
params.values: Launch Lookup Table Editor dialog box button

params.name: Index search method
params.values: Method of calculating table indices Linear search (default) | Evenly spaced points | Binary search

params.name: Begin index search using previous index result
params.values: Start using the index from the previous time step off (default) | on

params.name: Interpolation method
params.values: Method of interpolation between breakpoint values Linear point-slope (default) | Flat

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Zero (default) | Round
